# Housz

> Housz 的个人技术博客，记录数值计算、计算力学、机器人、图形学、数学与工程开发笔记。

Canonical site: https://www.housz.cn/

## Primary topics

- Numerical computing and numerical methods
- Computational mechanics and continuum mechanics
- Robotics and robot modeling
- Computer graphics and geometry
- Mathematics, calculus, optimization and linear algebra
- C++, Python and engineering development
